transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Yeah… I guess the main thing is I just don’t feel like myself anymore. It’s hard to explain without making it sound like I’m just being lazy, but it’s not that. I used to do things, you know? I hiked a lot, I coached, I played guitar—nothing professional, just something I cared about—and I’d keep up with people, return calls, make plans, that kind of thing.

Lately I don’t do any of it. I’ll see the guitar sitting there and I know I could pick it up, or I’ll think I should call someone back because they’ve left messages, or I’ll know I need to handle some basic thing around my place… and I just don’t move. I live in this small rental now, and some days I sit there for hours, just sitting, knowing there are things I should be doing, things I even used to want to do, and I can’t make myself start. It feels like something in me has gone quiet or shut off.
Can you describe how you’ve been feeling emotionally lately? For example, have you been feeling down, sad, or have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t know if I’d call it “sad” exactly. It’s not like I’m crying all the time or thinking, “I’m depressed,” in that straightforward way. It’s more like everything in me has gone flat, or quiet. Like the part of me that used to reach for things just isn’t there right now.

I used to hike a lot, and I coached, and I’d play guitar just because I liked it. I wasn’t great or anything, but it felt like mine, you know? And now the guitar is just sitting there. I see it, I know it’s there, I know I used to enjoy it, and I still can’t make myself pick it up. Same with people calling or texting—I know I should call them back, and sometimes I even rehearse in my head what I’d say, but then I just… don’t do it.

Some days I’ll sit in my small rental for hours, looking around at things that need to be done, and I know they need doing. It’s not that I don’t understand that. I just can’t seem to start. So, yeah, I’ve lost interest, or maybe lost the ability to feel interested. Mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore.
Have these feelings of being unmotivated and losing interest in things been happening most days, and lasting throughout much of the day, for a while now?

Yeah… most days. It’s not really like it comes and goes in a clear way, like “today I’m fine and tomorrow I’m not.” It’s more like it’s become the background of the day, almost every day.

I’ll wake up and I already feel sort of stalled. I’ll think, okay, I should get up, I should take care of the place, I should maybe go outside, maybe pick up the guitar for ten minutes, maybe call someone back so they don’t think I’m ignoring them. And I can see all of that in my head, like I know the steps, I know what a normal version of me would do. But then hours pass, and I’m still just sitting there in that small rental, looking at things that need doing, and I haven’t started any of it.

It’s been going on long enough that it doesn’t feel like just a bad day or being tired. I stopped hiking, I stopped coaching, I stopped playing guitar, I stopped returning calls the way I used to. Mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy level or felt fatigued even without doing much physically lately?

Yeah… I think so, but it’s hard for me to separate “tired” from just… not being able to get myself going. I’m not out doing some hard physical job and then coming home exhausted, you know? A lot of days I’ve barely done anything at all, and I still feel like I have no push in me.

I’ll be sitting in that small rental and I’ll look around and know there are basic things I should do, nothing major, just normal things, and it feels like even starting takes more energy than I have. It’s not like my muscles are sore exactly. It’s more like the engine won’t turn over. I can sit there for hours thinking, “Okay, get up now, do this one thing,” and then I just don’t.

And it’s the same with things I used to actually like. Hiking, coaching, playing guitar, calling people back—those used to be part of me. Now they feel far away, like they belong to somebody else. So yeah, I guess my energy is down, but mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating much less or much more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

I’m not really sure, honestly. I haven’t been tracking it the way I probably should. I don’t think I’ve had some obvious big change where my clothes suddenly don’t fit or anything like that, at least not that I’ve noticed.

Food has been kind of… incidental, I guess. Like some days I eat because I realize it’s been a while, not because I’m especially hungry, but I don’t know if that’s less than usual or just me not paying attention. Other times I’ll just grab whatever’s easy. I haven’t been weighing myself, so I can’t really say if I’ve lost or gained weight.

So… no clear change that I can point to. Mostly I just haven’t been noticing my appetite much.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?

I don’t know… I’m not sure I’d put it that way. I mean, I don’t walk around thinking, “I’m worthless,” exactly. It’s more like I get frustrated with myself because I can see what I’m not doing, if that makes sense.

Like, I know there are things I should be able to handle, ordinary things, and when I don’t do them I’ll think, “What is wrong with me?” But I don’t know if that’s guilt or just confusion, or embarrassment maybe. It’s not like I have one big thing I’m blaming myself for. I just notice the gap between how I used to be and how I am now, and it bothers me.

So… maybe a little self-critical, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling like I’m not good enough in some clear, constant way. I’m mostly just trying to understand why I’m like this.
Have you ever felt like this before—like you’ve lost interest in things and can’t get yourself going—or is this the first time you’ve experienced something like this?

I mean… I don’t think I’ve felt it like this before. Not in this same way. Everybody has stretches where they’re tired or they don’t feel like doing much, and I’ve had that, sure. But this feels different, more like I’ve drifted away from myself somehow.

Before, if I got into a rut, I could usually push through it. I’d go hiking, or I’d play guitar for a while, or I’d get involved with coaching and that would sort of pull me back into myself. I’d call people back eventually. I might put things off, but I still felt connected to those things.

Now it’s like… I know those things used to matter to me, but I don’t feel the pull toward them. I stopped hiking, I haven’t been coaching, I don’t really pick up the guitar, and I avoid calling people back even when I know I should. And some days I’m just sitting in that small rental for hours, looking at things that need to be done, and I know exactly what they are, but I can’t make myself start.

So, no, I wouldn’t say this is just a normal repeat of something I’ve had before. Mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore.

Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or so confident that you took risks you normally wouldn’t, like spending too much money, making big decisions quickly, or feeling like you didn’t need much sleep?

I don’t think so. Not in the way you’re describing, anyway.

I’ve had times where I was more keyed up, like if work was intense or there was something that needed doing, and I could push through being tired for a while. But that felt more like pressure, or stress, not like I was on top of the world or anything. I don’t remember feeling unusually confident in a way where I suddenly thought I could do anything or started making big choices without thinking.

I’m usually pretty cautious, honestly. Maybe too cautious. Spending money or making big decisions fast isn’t really something I associate with myself. And with sleep… I mean, there have been nights where I didn’t sleep well, but I don’t think I’ve had that thing where I only needed a couple hours and felt great anyway.

So, no, I can’t really point to a period like that. If it happened, it wasn’t obvious to me.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt persistently down, lost interest in things, or had trouble getting motivated for a while, before this current episode?

I’m trying to think back, because I don’t want to answer too quickly and make it sound cleaner than it was. I’ve had rough patches before, sure—times where I was tired, or work took a lot out of me, or I didn’t feel like doing much for a few days. But this current thing feels… more settled in, I guess. More like I’m not myself.

Before, even if I was in a slump, I still had some kind of connection to the things that mattered to me. I’d still end up hiking eventually, or I’d pick up the guitar, or coaching would get me out of my own head. I might ignore a phone call and then call back later. It wasn’t perfect, but I could sort of restart myself.

Now it’s different. I stopped hiking, I’m not coaching, I don’t really play guitar, and I don’t call people back like I should. And it isn’t always because I’m sitting there feeling sad in some obvious way. Sometimes I’m just… stuck. I’ll sit in that little rental for hours, and I can see the dishes or the laundry or whatever needs doing, and I know I should just get up and start, but I can’t seem to make myself do it.

So if you’re asking whether I’ve had this same kind of loss of interest and motivation before, I don’t think so. Not like this. This feels like I’ve kind of drifted away from the person I used to be.
Have you had more than one time in your life when you felt persistently down, lost interest in things, or had trouble getting motivated for a while, before this current episode?

I don’t think I’ve had more than one time like this, no. I mean, I’ve had periods where I was tired or kind of flat, but I keep coming back to the fact that this feels different from those. This isn’t just a bad week or me needing a break.

Mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore. Things that used to kind of anchor me are just… gone from my routine. I stopped hiking, which used to clear my head. I haven’t been coaching. I barely touch the guitar. And I don’t call people back, even when I know I should and even when there’s no good reason not to.

It’s not like I’m sitting there making a decision to avoid everything. That’s the part that bothers me. Some days I’m in that small rental for hours, and I can see what needs to be done—laundry, dishes, whatever—and I know it should be simple to stand up and start, but I just don’t. It’s like the starting part doesn’t happen.

So, before this? Not really. I’ve had rough stretches, but I don’t remember having this kind of long, heavy loss of interest and motivation more than once. This current thing is the one that feels like I’ve drifted away from who I was.
